title: Atomic software work 11: paginate
description: Independent GenLayer consensus test for a distinct paginate implementation.
deliverables: Implementation and focused tests for paginate

criteria.requirement: paginate must return a stable page slice
criteria.passCondition: Retrieved implementation and tests directly demonstrate that return a stable page slice
criteria.failureCondition: The behavior is missing, contradicted, or not evidenced: return a stable page slice

criteria.requirement: paginate must reject page numbers below one
criteria.passCondition: Retrieved implementation and tests directly demonstrate that reject page numbers below one
criteria.failureCondition: The behavior is missing, contradicted, or not evidenced: reject page numbers below one

criteria.requirement: paginate must never mutate the input array
criteria.passCondition: Retrieved implementation and tests directly demonstrate that never mutate the input array
criteria.failureCondition: The behavior is missing, contradicted, or not evidenced: never mutate the input array
